verdict.rationale: No claimed-docs evidence pack item shows a published per-signal pricing page; only community anecdotes exist, and they are contradictory (one says price is always on the website, others describe needing an account manager for discounts and losing a $6M account due to 'lack of billing transparency'). Without a docs-tier citation to a public pricing page, there is no basis to credit Datadog with transparent published per-signal pricing that lets an SRE self-serve cost predictions without sales involvement. missing for 10: an official Datadog pricing/cost-calculator doc citation, evidence of per-signal (not per-host/bundle) rates being public, and confirmation that volume/committed pricing doesn't require sales negotiation.
